notes: Clauses about life span, death, named diseases and physical defects are omitted under the sensitive-topics policy; affected rules list them in 'dropped'.

skipped.reason: Timing of the father's death: excluded by policy.

variants.text: A strong 9th lord in the 9th: fortunate.
Jupiter in the 9th, the 9th lord in an angle and a strong ascendant lord: extremely fortunate.

rules.text: A strong 9th lord, Venus in the 9th and Jupiter in an angle: the father will be fortunate.
Mars in the 2nd or 4th from the 9th house with a debilitated 9th lord: the father's finances are strained.
rules.note: Encoded as Mars in the 10th or 12th house (2nd or 4th from the 9th).

rules.text: The 9th lord in an angle aspected by Jupiter: the father holds high position and comfort.
The 9th and 10th lords exchange houses with a benefic aspect: the father is wealthy and well known.

variants.text: The Sun exalted and the 9th lord in the 11th: religious, favoured by authority and devoted to the father.
The Sun in a trine and the 9th lord in the 7th with Jupiter's influence: great devotion to the father.

rules.text: The 2nd and 9th lords exchange houses: fortune, vehicles and fame (the text times it around the 32nd year).
The ascendant lord and the 6th lord together in the 9th: friction between father and child.
Weak 10th and 3rd lords with a debilitated or combust 9th lord: severe financial hardship.
Venus exalted with the 9th lord and Saturn in the 3rd: fortunate in many ways.

variants.text: Jupiter in the 9th and the 9th lord in an angle: abundant wealth.
Mercury exalted and the 9th lord in the 9th: abundant wealth after the 36th year.

rules.text: The ascendant and 9th lords exchange houses with Jupiter in the 7th: gains of wealth and vehicles.
Rahu in the 5th, the 5th lord in the 8th and a debilitated 9th lord: fortune is lacking.
Saturn and the Moon in the 9th with a debilitated ascendant lord: severe financial hardship.
